sections.text:
The temporary fall protection systems for climbing towers require the use of a
16 mm nylon rope. This rope
is not qualified as a live line rope and thus must be kept outside the absolute
limits of approach to an
energized conductor.

In some wind conditions or tower configuration it may be difficult to control
the temporary fall protection rope so that it is kept outside the absolute
limits of approach to an energized conductor. In such cases, a full length rope
should be used so that its weight will require higher wind pressure to blow it
close to a conductor.

To further control
the movement of the rope, it should be fed through a large karabiner connected
to the tower leg near the energized conductor.
